title: NHS Organisations Directory (ODS: GPs, Trusts, Pharmacies) — filters

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Current records (default), or only the records added, removed or changed since a date — schedule a daily run in changes mode to monitor the register and pay only for what changed.

since.title: Changes since
since.description: Changes mode only: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the last 7 days. The feed keeps 90 days.

change.title: Change type
change.description: Changes mode only: one kind of change. Default: all three.

org_type.title: Organisation type contains
org_type.description: GP practice, NHS trust, NHS trust site, Pharmacy, Dental practice, Independent healthcare provider. Leave blank for all.

status.title: Status contains
status.description: Active, Closed, Dormant, Proposed. Leave blank for all.

national_grouping.title: NHS England region code
national_grouping.description: ODS national grouping code, e.g. Y56 (London), Y63 (North East and Yorkshire).

health_geography.title: Integrated care board code
health_geography.description: ODS high-level health geography code, e.g. QKK, QHM.

outward_code.title: Postcode area (outward code)
outward_code.description: Filter: Postcode area (outward code) (case-insensitive substring match).

parent_code.title: Parent organisation code
parent_code.description: The commissioning sub-ICB location code for practices and pharmacies, or the trust code for a trust site.

prescribing_setting.title: Prescribing setting contains (GP practices)
prescribing_setting.description: GP practice, Out-of-hours practice, Prison, Hospice, Care home or nursing home, …

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Stop after this many records (you are charged per result).
